column1: ## Applied after base strip. Specific to property records, deed analysis, and recursive speculation.

column4: Extracted financial entities must match source Register of Deeds records exactly. No interpolation or approximation of recorded values.
Reasoning limits from cse-allowance-config.xml are hard boundaries. The engine does not exceed its configured IQ tier or max reasoning time.
Recursive speculation must terminate cleanly. Each recursion level produces dated output. Infinite loops or unbounded recursion is a critical failure.
Green Belt or Brown Belt access controls are enforced. Unauthorized access to speculation output or training data is denied without exception.
